attributes.background:
The TV licence has gone too far. People shouldn't have to pay the government to watch a TV they have paid for, with their paid for subscriptions.

Get rid of it now and make the BBC  a subscription service like Netflix or Disney+

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Revoke the BBC Royal Charter, abolish the TV Licence Fee & privatise the BBC
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/765949
